_about: Fixes from the build reviews, applied by build_words.py after the curation. glosses: card glosses rephrased so no English apostrophe sits beside an ʻokina (DESIGN §4.4). words: per-word sense changes. stones: cognates withheld because the same form, in POLLEX's own data for that language, carries an excretory or genital sense (a reader who knows the language would hear it).

glosses.hoahānau: cousin; kin of the same generation
glosses.paʻa kāhili: kāhili bearer, attendant of a chief

makaʻala.reason: ʻala on its own is 'fragrant' and 'awake' is ala (PPN *q leaves no ʻokina), so the stone cannot be glossed 'awake' without teaching a false root; left unresolved until Pukui & Elbert's Lit. settles it (DECISIONS B10).

kē.reason: Māori tē is also POLLEX TEE.1, glossed with an excretory sense

kā#0.reason: Māori tā has an excretory homograph in POLLEX

alo.reason: QARO.A glosses Māori aro and Tongan ʻao with genital senses

hulu#0.reason: FULU.1 glosses Tongan fulu with a genital sense
